  mcp          Run the local MCP bridge.

  trace        Inspect the local run trace ledger.
  debug        Create local debug bundles.

  finalize     Finalize a run after human review.
  eval         Run evaluation harnesses. Milestone command.
  completions  Generate shell completion scripts from the typed clap command tree.
  docs         Generate documentation artifacts from CLI metadata.
  repo         Inspect repository stack and quality plan.
  quality      Plan or rerun quality gates.
  vcs          Prepare and inspect local Git worktrees.
  memory       Inspect memory controller status.
  status       Print bootstrap CLI status.

Options:

          Print help
